long: KKND2: Krossfire is the sequel to Krush Kill 'n Destroy, a post-apocalyptic real-time strategy game adding a third faction, the underground Series 9 robots, alongside the Survivors and Evolved. Players gather resources, construct bases and wage war across single-player campaigns and multiplayer skirmishes. It moved to a fully sprite-based engine with refined unit control.
name: KKND2: Krossfire
short: KKND2: Krossfire (Beam Software 1998, GOG, via Proton)
